text.en: Most pet owners highlight how happy and energetic their dogs are after running in open play groups matched by personality. However, a couple of clients reported serious concerns after extended boarding, citing skin abrasions, hair loss, or stomach illness requiring veterinary intervention upon returning home.

title.en: Spacious ranch setting with farm features

text.en: Clients frequently praise the unique farm-style environment, featuring large shaded grassy yards, sprinklers, and air-conditioned indoor kennels. Reviewers enjoy that their dogs can explore open grounds alongside farm animals like chickens and horses, while relaxing to soothing music played during rest periods.

Multiple reviewers compliment the attentive caretakers who actively supervise group play sessions and keep boarding facilities tidy. When a customer reported a holiday scheduling issue, management directly contacted the owner to resolve the billing concern and offer an apology.

q.en: What type of boarding environment is offered for dogs?

a.en: The facility features a farm-style ranch layout with large outdoor play areas, shaded grassy yards, sprinklers, and indoor kennels with air conditioning.

q.en: Are play groups supervised by staff members?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that caretakers supervise dogs during outdoor play sessions and match pets according to size and temperament.

q.en: Do owners receive updates during boarding stays?

a.en: Some clients receive photo updates and messages during extended stays, though experiences with update consistency vary among pet parents.
